title: Minimum Positive Sum Subarray
summary: Given an integer array nums and two integers l and r, find the smallest sum of a contiguous subarray whose length is between l and r (inclusive) and whose sum is positive.
statement: Given an integer array nums and two integers l and r, find the smallest sum of a contiguous subarray whose length is between l and r (inclusive) and whose sum is positive. Return this minimum sum if such a subarray exists; otherwise, return -1.
constraints: Consider every contiguous subarray whose length is between l and r inclusive.
Among those with strictly positive sum, return the smallest sum.
Return -1 when no eligible subarray has positive sum.
hints: Maintain its sum while sliding one position at a time.
Update the answer only for strictly positive totals.
All eligible subarrays are visited once; -1 represents the absence of a positive candidate.
editorial: All eligible subarrays are visited once; -1 represents the absence of a positive candidate.

tests.explanation: The length-two subarray [3,-2] has positive sum one, the minimum possible.
Every length-two sum is nonpositive, so return -1.
